summaries.summary: Lula wins a record fourth presidential term in Brazil, defeating the far-right and defying political figures such as Trump and Meta. This historic victory has caused stocks in Brazil to plummet.

Reports indicate that some iPhone Duo models are cracking due to suspected hinge damage, while other articles discuss Tesla's partnership with Turo to enhance the adoption of its Full Self-Driving software and details surrounding the OLED debut of the iPad mini 8.

Rahul Gandhi acquitted in a 2018 defamation case concerning remarks made against Amit Shah. Additionally, former DMK Minister Anbil Mahesh Poyyamozhi has been arrested in a fraud case involving private schools.
A study reveals that AI technologies have not generated financial payoffs for most companies, indicating a disparity between investment and returns.
The US is prepared to strike Iran within 96 hours following a potential signal from Trump, heightening tensions ahead of significant elections in Israel.
Grok has released the first seven minutes of its AI-generated film, 'Odyssey,' showcasing initial footage that lacks artistry or human interest.
In ongoing legal proceedings, Giribala Singh claims that comments made during a heated moment over an abortion do not constitute incitement to suicide in the Twisha Sharma case.
